d:
Lawyers from nearly 48 districts of Uttar Pradesh gathered in Lucknow on November 14 and marched towards the state Assembly, demanding the implementation of the Advocate Protection Act. The protest turned tense as demonstrators broke police barricades and clashed with security personnel. Lawyers have also demanded toll tax exemption, insurance schemes and better facilities in court premises.
